name: user-login-shell
description: Practice-box account-hardening finding: gives an account an interactive login shell (the wrong thing for a service identity). Vars: USERNAME (required); LOGIN_SHELL (optional, default /bin/bash); SYSTEM (optional '1' to create as a system account if it does not exist).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "${USERNAME:?USERNAME is required}"
shell="${LOGIN_SHELL:-/bin/bash}"

if id "$USERNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    usermod -s "$shell" "$USERNAME"
elif [ "${SYSTEM-}" = "1" ]; then
    useradd -r -m -s "$shell" "$USERNAME"
else
    useradd -m -s "$shell" "$USERNAME"
fi
